silhouette.reason: Mohawk, tusks and heavy shoulders read as an orc; the head sits upright, not hunched.
fixes: push the trapezius higher and the head forward (hunched stance)

proportions.reason: The face underneath is a human face tinted green: narrow nose, no brow shelf.
fixes: flatten the nose bridge and widen the nostrils; heavy brow shelf over lowered eyes

materials.reason: Green matte skin, ivory tusks with some gradient, the mohawk is a dark slab that reads like a helmet crest more than hair.
fixes: skin strip with sheen; hair strip with anisotropic sheen and loose tips on the crest

detail.reason: Tusks, teeth, scar and crest; no skin wrinkles or pores.
fixes: LOD0 wrinkle/pore displacement and a gum strip

wear.reason: A clear cheek scar and blotchy skin tell some history.
fixes: chipped tusk tip and a second scar

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 is a distance-field re-mesh: the face breaks into flat patches of different tone and the features smear. Tusks survive.
fixes: LOD2 from an authored coarse topology (decimated quad base mesh) instead of the distance-field re-mesh, keeping vertex colour smooth
